title: fix: respect outer visibility across Web Chat
body:
<!-- Please provide the issue number here if any -->

> Fixes #5472

## Changelog Entry

- Fixed [#5472](https://github.com/microsoft/BotFramework-WebChat/issues/5472), ensure proper inheritance from the outside of Web Chat for visibility CSS property when hidden, in PR [#5473](https://github.com/microsoft/BotFramework-WebChat/pull/5473), by [@OEvgeny](https://github.com/OEvgeny)

## Description

This ensures we mostly don't use `visibility: visible` due to its ability to reveal things if hidden upper in the tree.

## Design

Use `unset` in place of `visible` as it resets the value to the initial one, which is properly inherited: https://codepen.io/OEvgeny/pen/qEExOdg

## Specific Changes

- Changed `visibility: visible` occurrences to `visibility: unset`.
